name: Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder and Hand
description: 30-item self-report questionnaire measuring physical function and symptoms in upper extremity conditions. Lower score = less disability.
copyright: Free to use with attribution (Institute for Work & Health)
shirleySays: ICC 0.92–0.96. MDC: 10.8 pts. MCID: 10–15 pts. 30-item questionnaire. Validated in shoulder, rotator cuff, lateral epicondylitis, carpal tunnel, fractures, distal radius. More sensitive to change than QuickDASH in specific conditions.

scoring.mcidNote: 10–15 pts MCID; healthy adult mean ≈10; MDC 10.8 pts
